description: Regression test: a pending TypeLookup request that is never answered must time out, fail the
entry and re-request the endpoints queued behind it from their own type server.
Same setup as Case_13, but the publisher that starves its builtin flow controller announces a
lease duration longer than the whole test, so the subscriber never detects it as gone and the
participant removal path cannot resolve the pending request.
The subscriber sets a short request timeout, so only the timeout can resolve TypeBig and let it
match the second publisher. On the timeout the first publisher is failed instead of removed, as
it is still there, so the subscriber pairs with it by type name and ends up matching both.
Before the fix the subscriber never discovers the second publisher's writer and times out.
